description: Use this when the user asks why a site keeps alerting, which monitors are noisy or flapping, whether alerts were false alarms, or how to get fewer pointless alerts: "why does FlareWarden keep emailing us about the API?", "which of our monitors are flaky?". Returns, over the last 7 and 30 days for the sites the user can see, worst first: alerts for outages the next check found over, content checks, dependencies and cron jobs that alert often, anomaly alerts, sites whose status keeps changing, and failed checks other regions overturned as false alarms (by region); each with a suggested change and the tool that makes it. Changes nothing. Not for what is down now: use get_account_overview or diagnose_site. Not for what is not monitored: use review_coverage.

group.description: Only sites in this group (exact name).

site.description: Only this site: its id, name or part of its URL.
